summary: Install the full ansible with pipx install --include-deps ansible, or ansible-core alone, optionally pinned to a version.
questions: How do I install Ansible with pipx?
How do I install a specific ansible-core version with pipx?
Why do I need --include-deps with pipx for ansible?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible with pipx
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
pipx install --include-deps ansible     # full package
pipx install ansible-core               # minimal
pipx install ansible-core==2.12.3       # pinned version
```
`--include-deps` exposes the commands from ansible-core that the `ansible` package depends on.
